capabilities: Scrub a vault-wide time slider to see which notes changed since a moment
Show per-note diffs with changed words highlighted
Restore one note, a deleted note, a copy, or all changes since a moment
Snapshot notes automatically 20 seconds after editing stops
Thin out old history on a retention schedule or drop history past N days
disambiguation: Not a backup solution; the README calls it a safety net and tells users to keep a real backup of the vault too.
extras: README warns the plugin is "a safety net, not a backup" and to keep real backups; it also discloses no network use, telemetry, or payments, and that only Markdown notes under 2 MB are tracked.
motivation: The author ported Starnote's version history approach to Obsidian as an independent project.
problem: Getting usable note history in Obsidian normally means setting up git or a sync service; this adds automatic local per-note history with no setup.

relations.evidence: An independent project, ported from Starnote's version history.
Run BRAT: Add a beta plugin for testing and enter encomjp/obsidian-time-machine

summary: Vault-wide version history that saves note snapshots locally and lets you scrub a time slider, read diffs, and restore single notes or the whole vault without git.
